title: Spartan wave 3 art
whats_new: Reworked to your wave 3 picks: only metals the mod really makes tools from. Thermal, Draconic, Iron's Spellbooks, Astral Sorcery and Fieldframe are gone; Eternal Starlight now has all 9 tool metals, Eidolon is silver only, Ender IO is dark steel only, Psi is psimetal only.

items.title: Botania weapons
items.detail: Spartan iron sprites recoloured to each metal's own ingot, all 24 kinds and every bow and crossbow state. Each sheet: vanilla iron sword, Spartan iron longsword and the source item on top, then every kind at 1x (iron, recolour) and 4x.
items.ask: Good = ship these colours, Bad = drop the material.
